claim: Cannot recover deleted Yahoo emails : r/datarecovery - Reddit
summary: I called Yahoo customer service, and they were useless. I told them on the phone, "17 years of emails were deleted without my permission, and I want to recover them". The woman on the phone said, "We can't help you with that". There is an online "tool" in which you can request that Yahoo recover emails that have been deleted within the past 7 days.
